descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating the town of Zorah (also spelled Tsorah, Tzorah), a city in the Shephelah of Judah allotted to Dan (Josh 15:33, 19:41). Famous as the birthplace of Samson (Judg 13:2, 25) and the base from which the Danite spies set out (Judg 18:2, 8, 11). Also mentioned in the fortification list of Rehoboam (2 Chr 11:10) and the post-exilic resettlement (Neh 11:29). Consistently rendered Arabic Sur'a (صُرْعَة), Korean Sora (소라), Spanish Zora/Sora, German Tsorah/Zorah. All prepositional variants (from-Zorah, and-Zorah, in-Zorah) refer to the same geographic location identified with modern Sar'ah west of Jerusalem.
